pwa.title: Install farmaccountant Shortcut
pwa.desc: Add this app to your Home Screen for a faster, full-screen ledger experience and convenient offline bookkeeping.
pwa.manual_instructions:
To install FarmAccountant:

• On Android/Chrome: Tap the 3 dots in the top-right corner of Chrome and select 'Add to Home screen' or 'Install app'.
• On Desktop Chrome/Edge: Click the install icon in the address bar at the top-right.
